records.issue_text: Removing the final member on a later page reloads with an invalid existing offset, leaving the UI on an empty page instead of returning to the new last page.
records.rationale: The mechanism is traceable in the diff: removeMember() in group.js calls self.findMembers() after the DELETE, and findMembers clamps offset via Math.min(this.get("user_count"), Math.max(this.get("offset"), 0)) but never resets offset to a valid page start. Since offset is never written back to the model after deletion (setProperties uses result.meta.offset from the server echo of the clamped request), the controller's stale offset can remain exactly at or past the last valid page boundary (e.g. user_count becomes a multiple of limit while offset equals that multiple), yielding an empty member
